purpose: Trigger-boundary regression set for ugt-nextjs-clean-code. S* queries must route to ugt-nextjs-clean-code; N* queries must NOT (their expected target is informational). Emphasis on the two live boundaries: clean-code vs ugt-nextjs-pitfalls (code smell vs runtime bug) and clean-code vs ugt-nextjs-cicd-setup (fixing violations vs Sonar/Jenkins infra).
method: 3 independent judges, randomized order, masked query ids, full skill listing incl. superpowers distractors

baseline_result.note: optimizer loop terminated at iteration 0 — 60/60 on first run. Both live boundaries held: all runtime-symptom N-cases routed to ugt-nextjs-pitfalls and all Sonar-infra N-cases to ugt-nextjs-cicd-setup, while every violation-fixing S-case (incl. 'pipeline green except new_violations' and 'Quality Gate แดง new_violations') stayed on clean-code.
